title: Cognitive and linguistic features of adolescent argumentative writing: Do connectives signal more complex reasoning?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:

Decent study on "connectives" which operationalized in #argumentative #ccss #writing study as transitions and text structurew.

While the study used essay length as a proxy for ability (would prefer prvious writing scores...though single item assessments as covaraites scary) it reaffirms importance of focusing on text structure and transition words.
